name: MediaFetch Pro Adobe CEP
releaseNotes: v1.0.8: Universal any-link media extraction for Dribbble (1080p video shots & animations), Fiverr (gig demo reels & portfolio samples), ArtStation (video reels & 4K art), Apple Music (audio preview player & artwork), Behance (video renditions, Vimeo/YouTube embeds), and resilient universal fallback for any website hosting video or audio assets across desktop plugins and mobile APK.
Added support for Dribbble video shots, Fiverr gig portfolios, ArtStation demo reels, Apple Music preview audio & artwork, and Behance project media.
Smart universal link extractor: downloads video and audio from any website or creative showcase.
Authentic platform badges and enhanced direct media preview player.
Optimized headless WebView sniffing for challenge-protected creative platforms.
